_comment: Copy to the PROJECT ROOT as fusions.json. Declares sub-features that are MEANT to overlap inside one part's union() -- a boss that blends into the tower it mounts on, a rib that runs into a wall. Passed to check_subfeature_overlap.py as --exempt by validate_scad.sh whenever this file exists at the project root; without it, every intentional blend is reported as an unintended overlap. Silently excluding a pair is not an option: like joints.json's declared contacts, this is a written decision with a reason.
reason: boss_a is the mounting boss for tower_main -- it blends into the tower by design, 180mm3 of intentional fusion

_comment: Fields: pair (the two sub-feature names exactly as they appear in the part's // SUBFEATURES: line) and reason (why the overlap is intended). One entry per intentional fusion. Delete these _comment entries and replace the example. If a pair is NOT listed here and overlaps, that is a real finding and the check fails -- raise --max-overlap-mm3 only when the threshold itself is wrong for the process, never to silence a known pair.
reason: rib_left terminates inside wall_back; the intersection is the joint, not an error
